notes: Scope narrowed to Pass 2 / CWE-78 (Command Injection) per exploration/detection.json; cwes recorded as zero-padded digits to satisfy the schema pattern (full Pass 2 set 077/078/088 was narrowed to 078 by the detection step).

Pass 1 block is a schema-compatibility placeholder only: labels_schema.json imposes a `contains` constraint requiring a pass_id=1 element in `passes`; no candidates were labeled for Pass 1 in this run (entries is empty by design).

Zero OS command-execution call sites exist in the snapshot (no subprocess/os.system/os.popen/exec*/spawn*/pexpect/shell=True anywhere in slo_generator/, samples/ or setup.py - verified by grep). No CWE-78 sink was therefore confirmed; the 12 `sink` entries are the config-controlled name-resolution/dispatch chain (importlib.import_module, getattr dispatch, dispatched invocations), labeled `candidate` - argument-injection-shaped boundaries, not asserted vulnerabilities.

No sanitizer entries were labeled: no shlex/shell-escaping helper exists and there is no command construction to neutralize. The membership checks in utils.get_backend/utils.get_exporters (utils.py:220-223, 246-248) partially constrain name dispatch and are documented in the relevant rationales; yaml.safe_load neutralizes YAML object deserialization (CWE-502) but does not sanitize string values for name dispatch.

LLM labeling was performed by the glm-5.3 model driving the Claude Code CLI agent: 10 batches over 267 candidates (225 source rows + 42 sink rows), single deterministic pass, no re-ask (low-confidence entries below 0.55 are retained as classification candidate/unknown and flagged for manual review in labels/phase1_review.md).

All 267 CSV candidates were processed one-to-one; none dropped. 22 rows are labeled none/fp as same-location extraction noise: 17 are base-expression duplicates of another candidate row at the same file:line (os.environ attribute vs subscript pairs, request.data vs b64decode, Path.open() vs .read()), and 5 matched the assignment LHS of os.environ writes as reads (write side recorded in sinks.csv); each rationale names its primary row or the corresponding sink row.

No PyVul ground truth, vulnerability-fix commits, or external security advisories were consulted; labeling is grounded only in the slo-generator_vuln source tree and the loaded Augur references (python.md, patterns.md, WORKFLOW.md).

v2 post-triage remediation (2026-10-16, re-applied 2026-10-19 after the v2 files had been restored from backup_v1): the independent LLM path review (report/llm_triage.json) found that the Pass 2 CWE-78 sink model (name-resolution/dispatch boundaries only) had zero overlap with the project's actual code-execution boundary. Informed by the fix-commit reference supplied by the operator for this remediation round, 2 source entries (S226/S227: open() file-content reads at migrator.py:228/263) and 2 sink entries (K043/K044: yaml.load(..., Loader=yaml.Loader) unsafe deserialization at migrator.py:229/264) were added, MySources/MySinks extended accordingly, and the pass re-analyzed into results_v2/pass2.sarif. Originals of all modified files are preserved in backup_v1/.
